# Test fixtures

Everything here is **synthetic**, generated by [`tools/fixtures/make-usdc.py`](../../../../tools/fixtures/make-usdc.py)
with Pixar USD (`pip install usd-core pillow numpy`). No real captures, photos or customer data.

| File | What it mimics |
| --- | --- |
| `object-capture-like.usdz` | Apple Object Capture output: binary USDC (crate) root layer, one triangulated mesh, indexed face-varying UVs and normals, UsdPreviewSurface with diffuse / normal (scale 2, bias -1) / occlusion PNGs in `0/`, metersPerUnit 1, upAxis Y. |
| `zup-cm-subsets.usdz` | Same bike authored differently: upAxis Z, centimeters, two GeomSubset materials (JPEG-textured wheels, flat red frame), un-indexed face-varying UVs, per-vertex normals, plus custom attributes holding values the crate format stores inline. |

Regenerate (deterministic):

```sh
python tools/fixtures/make-usdc.py object-capture apps/web/test/fixtures/object-capture-like.usdz
python tools/fixtures/make-usdc.py zup-subsets  apps/web/test/fixtures/zup-cm-subsets.usdz
```

Benchmark-sized models (`--detail 90 --tex 2048`, ~23 MB) are not committed.
